title: Early Childhood Educator
short: Plan and deliver early childhood curriculum for children aged 3–5.
details: We are looking for a nurturing Lead Teacher with minimum 2 years experience in early childhood education. Responsibilities include lesson planning, parent communication and child assessment.

title: Childcare Assistant
short: Support Lead Teachers with daily care routines and classroom activities.
details: Assist with supervision, meal times and play-based learning. Good communication and a caring manner required. Early childhood coursework or equivalent experience preferred.

title: Cook (Benedetto)
short: Prepare nutritious meals and snacks for children while maintaining a safe, clean kitchen.
details: We are looking for a reliable cook to prepare daily meals and snacks, follow food-safety and allergy protocols, and help keep the kitchen organized and sanitary.

title: Lead Teacher
short: Lead a preschool classroom and create a warm, engaging learning environment for children aged 3–5.
details: We are seeking a caring and experienced Lead Teacher to guide daily classroom activities, support children’s development, communicate with families, and mentor classroom staff. Experience in early childhood education, strong classroom leadership, and a nurturing approach are required.
